external_to_f2_mapping.reason: WP306 selects reference identities and does not mix KV/runtime-cache state into semantic selection. Future render/cache optimization belongs downstream of ContextView compilation.
Current WP306 never reads or summarizes payload bytes, so it cannot overwrite evidence with generated summary text.

Current bounded reference selection already offers a lower-dependency first step. Learned compression should only be tested downstream on non-authoritative payload text with exact original digests retained.
WP306 has repository component tests but no measured F2 workload ablation for tokens/bytes/cache hits/latency/evidence-retention.

current_strengths: Reference-only ContextItem design binds payload/source SHA-256 plus source generation and provenance/evidence references without reading payload semantics.
ContextView is explicitly classified as not truth/effect authority.
Required items and required channels fail closed when item/cost budgets cannot satisfy them.
Counterevidence, authority, hyperposition, completion deficit and do-not-repeat are distinct channels instead of one prose blob.
Selection is deterministic from explicit priority and stable item-id tie-breaks; omitted entries are sorted deterministically before return.
G3 EpistemicRecord adapter uses exact concrete types, preventing caller relabeling of hypotheses/retrieval priors/negative/unknown records into observed evidence.
No model call, summarizer, cache server, second memory store or second truth authority is introduced by WP306.

open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.observation: ContextItem.cost_units and ContextNeed.max_cost_units are generic caller-supplied integers; no source binding proves that a cost unit equals rendered tokens, bytes, latency or another measured resource.
open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.risk: A downstream renderer can dereference a large payload whose caller declared cost is small, so compile-time boundedness need not imply prompt-token boundedness.
open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.proposed_structural_delta: Add a separate deterministic ContextCostWitness or equivalent adapter binding payload_sha256 + renderer/tokenizer/model identity + measured byte/token counts; keep generic core compiler model-agnostic.
open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.falsifier: Show an existing current F2 source/receipt that already binds cost_units to exact rendered payload/tokenizer identity and demonstrates bounded rendered token cost.

open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.observation: priority_bp and required are explicit caller inputs; ContextNeed binds evidence_refs but no explicit selection-policy identity/generation/digest is present in the compiled view except indirectly through need_sha256.
open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.risk: Selection can be reproducible for the same inputs while the producer of ranking/required metadata remains opaque, permitting model- or caller-generated priorities to appear deterministic downstream.
open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.proposed_structural_delta: Bind ranking/requiredness producer identity and policy digest outside or inside ContextNeed; treat model-derived scores as measurements/candidates, never authority.
open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.falsifier: Show an existing typed upstream admission contract that binds every priority/required value to a deterministic policy identity and is carried into ContextNeed evidence lineage.

open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.observation: COUNTEREVIDENCE is available and omission is explicit, but preservation of a contradiction pair depends on caller-selected required items/channels; the compiler intentionally does not infer semantic linkage.
open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.risk: A consumer that ignores omitted-channel metadata could receive selected evidence while decisive counterevidence is omitted for budget reasons.
open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.proposed_structural_delta: Do not add semantic inference to the compiler. Instead define an upstream contradiction-set/required-channel policy and a downstream consumer rule: omitted COUNTEREVIDENCE or required contradiction refs must trigger ASK/expand/HOLD rather than silent certainty.
open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.falsifier: Demonstrate an existing consumer contract and executable test that guarantees contradiction closure or explicit unresolved state under bounded views.

open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.observation: OmittedContextItem keeps item_id + item_sha256 + channel + priority/cost/required + reason, but not source_ref/source_sha256/provenance_refs.
open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.risk: This is privacy-friendly but audit/re-entry depends on item_id/item_sha256 being resolvable through an external canonical item registry; that registry binding was not established in this E2 source read.
open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.proposed_structural_delta: Prefer a resolvable omission identity contract rather than exposing forbidden payload/source metadata inside the view; prove item_id/item_sha256 lookup identity and access controls.
open_gaps_not_yet_falsifiers.falsifier: Show an existing canonical ContextItem registry/resolver keyed by item_id+digest with generation/provenance validation.
